LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_ElfDrow.stages.0.label: drow traitor
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_ElfDrow.stages.0.descr: Living under the same roof as drow? Those lackeys of the Spider Queen betrayed the whole elven race.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_DrowElf.stages.0.label: surface elves
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_DrowElf.stages.0.descr: Those soft elves who live in the sun drove us into the Underdark long ago.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_GnomeDwarf.stages.0.de: A dwarven forge plus little gnomish gadgets; there's nothing we can't make.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_DwarfGnome.stages.0.de: Gnomes talk a bit much, but their craftsmanship is real, as reliable as the old neighbors in the mountains.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_GnomeMindFlayer.stages: Gnome brains are a delicacy to mind flayers. Living with one, I can't even sleep.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_KoboldGnome.stages.0.d: Gnomes peek at our traps and laugh at our tails.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_GnomeKobold.stages.0.d: Kobolds dig traps under my workbench and steal my gears as treasure.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_KoboldLich.stages.0.de: The lich smells like the dead and looks at us like it's picking experiment material.
Dwarves grab their axes the moment they see us; their blood-debt books are full of goblin names.
Goblins burned our mines and raided our wine cellars. Now we have to sleep in the same yard as them.
Elves have killed countless of our warriors and call it "guarding the forest".
The hobgoblin legions burned elven woodlands. I won't forget.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_GoblinoidHalfOrc.stage: Half-orcs are looked down on just like us, and fight just like us.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_HalfOrcGoblinoid.stage: Goblinoids are noisy, but on the battlefield they're good help, like little brothers of the tribe.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_HalflingDwarf.stages.0: Dwarven ale with halfling roast pie; nothing better.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_DwarfHalfling.stages.0: Halflings are small, but their appetite and drinking match any dwarf's.
